book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md: 设 $a, b, c, d$ 是非负实数, 满足 $ab + bc + cd + da = 1$. 求证: $$\frac{a^3}{b + c + d} + \frac{b^3}{a + c + d} + \frac{c^3}{a + d + b} + \frac{d^3}{a + b + c} \geqslant \frac{1}{3}.$$
original_text_md: 设 $a, b, c, d$ 是非负实数, 满足 $ab + bc + cd + da = 1$. 求证: $$\frac{a^3}{b + c + d} + \frac{b^3}{a + c + d} + \frac{c^3}{a + d + b} + \frac{d^3}{a + b + c} \geqslant \frac{1}{3}.$$
